svg.title: Borrowing capacity in 1946
svg.desc: New York City: approximately $150 million of remaining legal borrowing headroom. Triborough Authority: estimated $360 million of borrowing capacity. Nominal 1946 US dollars. These are different institutional measures, not cash balances or total debt.
